reason: Fresh-main repository audit after ordinary PR #588 merge proves current Product UI authority drift on main@fa7f8e43db6c6fed1df69644ecfe2b75cd7aefe2. Personal Access production authority and guard are implemented, but its tested request/OWNER administration controls remain in retired frontend/r32-system-center.js while the production renderer is Element ProductExperienceShell. The same current Element Product surface also leaks English-only title tooltips and uses user-visible ellipsis/no-wrap patterns that can truncate Chinese labels and relationship facts. This authorization is diagnostic-only. It authorizes one tests-only failure-first path so all currently observable Product-surface boundaries can be captured in one Fast Closure V2 diagnostic window before any production path is added by a same-work-package amendment. It does not authorize Learning authority expansion, cloud backup/restore, system-DPI font automation, release/publish, workflow changes, dependency changes, legacy frontend reactivation, or a second Product renderer.
